title: Mixture of Layers: Dynamic Layer Routing for Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.09440v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pre-trained vision encoders contain layer-wise visual representations that differ in spatial granularity, semantic abstraction, and sensitivity to local details. However, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on only the final or penultimate vision encoder representations or fixed aggregation rules, making visual abstraction largely query-agnostic and limiting access to fine-grained cues such as small objects, spatial details, text, and subtle visual attributes. In this work, we propose Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned layer routing approach at the visual patch level that dynamically aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers. Given a text query, MoL predicts routing probabilities over vision encoder layers and performs a top-k sparse aggregation over selected hidden states at either the image level, patch level, or through a hybrid routing mechanism.

translated_title: 混合层：面向视觉推理的动态层路由方法
translated_abstract: 预训练视觉编码器中包含逐层的视觉表征，这些表征在空间粒度、语义抽象层次以及对局部细节的敏感性上各不相同。然而，大多数多模态大语言模型（MLLM）仅依赖视觉编码器的最后一层或倒数第二层的表征，或采用固定的聚合规则，这使得视觉抽象在很大程度上与查询无关，并限制了对细粒度线索（如小物体、空间细节、文字和细微视觉属性）的获取。在这项工作中，我们提出了混合层方法，这是一种指令条件化的、在视觉图像块（patch）级别进行的层路由方法，能够动态聚合来自视觉编码器中间层的与查询相关的潜在表征。给定一个文本查询，MoL 会预测视觉编码器各层的路由概率，并在图像级别、图像块级别或通过混合路由机制，对选定的隐藏状态执行 top-k 稀疏聚合。
tldr: 提出混合层方法，一种指令条件化的动态层路由机制，可根据文本查询从视觉编码器的中间层动态聚合与查询相关的潜在表征，从而增强多模态大语言模型对细粒度视觉线索的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned dynamic layer routing method that aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers, enabling MLLMs to better exploit fine-grained visual cues for visual reasoning.
